topic_title: Taiwan Equity Market Environment / Market State Observation
scope_definition: Bounded literature review for identifying defensible contemporaneously observable dimensions of the Taiwan equity market environment. Scope excludes forward-return prediction, stock selection, state-to-return mapping, threshold optimization and trading-rule construction.

search_boundary.canonical_master_corpus: 147-entry Taiwan Stock Market Master Corpus as of 2026-11-02
search_boundary.master_p1_status: 15/15 required P1 domains at least PROVISIONALLY_SATURATED
search_boundary.topic_subset_rule: Include Taiwan evidence materially relevant to regime/transition, volatility/tail, liquidity, microstructure/order flow, institutional flow, leverage/short selling, industry synchronization/diffusion, attention/herding, ownership/concentration and market-design context.
search_boundary.external_discovery: Targeted discovery of Taiwan futures/spot, implied-volatility and cross-market transmission studies was used only to test whether external context is materially missing. These discovery-level sources are not used to define a predictive rule and do not override canonical FULL_READ evidence.
search_boundary.exclusion: P2 domains not material to contemporaneous environment observation are not required for this bounded gate. Derivatives and cross-market evidence remain secondary/contextual pending later source and PIT audits.

canonical_ledger_version: P1 closure authority 2026-11-02; 147 entries; 67 FULL_READ / 26 PARTIAL / 54 FOUND_ONLY
saturation_assessment: PASS for the narrow observation-layer question. The literature is sufficient to bound the initial state-vector architecture and reject universal single-label/single-score interpretations. Additional papers are unlikely to change the initial dimension families materially; the major unresolved questions are PIT observability, data lineage, historical rule/version reconstruction, missingness and current data capability.
unresolved_material_conflicts: Market/sector states can diverge and ex-post regime labels have recognition latency.
Nonlinear or latent regime models do not reliably improve real-state OOS recognition.
High volatility/tail stress has strategy-specific rather than universal meaning.
Institutional flow information content is heterogeneous by investor type, aggressiveness, horizon and herding intensity.
Liquidity contains systematic/industry commonality and proxy contamination.
Margin, retail short and institutional SBL can have different or opposite meanings.
Industry spillover direction and transmitter/receiver roles can reverse by regime.
Attention/herding proxies do not identify latent emotions.
External/futures variables may add context but are not yet justified as core state-defining dimensions.

clean_path.legacy_work_treatment: PRE_LITERATURE_CONTAMINATED and excluded from confirmatory evidence for this project
clean_path.clarification: The final field applies to this fresh Market Environment Observation project path only. Earlier HENGCE regime/state/model work is explicitly excluded as contaminated legacy work.
